31: /// A source's current observation, without the bus's expiry grace. All three
32: /// processes use the same kernel monotonic clock on one lamp.
33: fn fresh(message: &Message, source: &str, since: u64, now: u64) -> bool {
34:     !message.expired
35:         && message.header.source == source
36:         && message.header.at_us >= since
37:         && message.header.at_us <= now
38:         && now - message.header.at_us <= FRESH_US
39:         && message
40:             .header
41:             .expires_ms
42:             .is_some_and(|ms| ms > 0 && ms <= 500)
43: }
